how1: Lembani zomwe akugula (kapena dinani 🍚 Mpunga, thumba la 20 lb pamitengo yeniyeni yamsika).
how2: Lowetsani mtengo wa imodzi ku United States (kapena dinani chip).
how4: Onjezani wolandila aliyense: dinani dzikolo, onjezani dzina / zachifundo.
how5: Mzere uliwonse umasonyeza zomwe ziyenera kutumiza; lembani mtengo weniweni wapafupi ngati mukudziwa.
how6: Total ili pansi; dinani Koperani dongosolo kuti mugawane.
how7: Kapena tsegulani mndandanda wazomwe mukufuna: sankhani zomwe akufuna, lembani zolembazo, kenako perekani patsamba la mishoni.
howp: Izi zimapanga ndalama. Simatumiza ndalama kapena kutsimikizira mabungwe othandizira. Perekani kudzera patsamba lililonse lovomerezeka la mishoni.
nosend: Pulogalamuyi situmiza ndalama kapena kutsimikizira mabungwe othandizira. Perekani kudzera patsamba lililonse lovomerezeka la mishoni.
about1: Miyezo yamitengo ikuchokera ku World Bank (mulingo wamitengo yapakhomo, makamaka 2024; US = 100, yosungidwa ngati 1.0). Mitengo yosinthira ilipo lero. Mtengo wa boma = mtengo waku US × PPP yake ya 2024, idasinthidwa kukhala madola lero. Mitengo yovomerezeka ndi mtengo wamoyo, osati golosale imodzi komanso mtengo wamawaya wamasiku ano. Lembani mtengo pamene weniweniwo umadziwika (wowonetsedwa ngati "mtengo wanu").
about2: amagwiritsa ntchito mitengo yeniyeni ya mpunga m’malo mwa mtengo wake: US kuchokera ku Bureau of Labor Statistics (mndandanda wa APU0000701312, pafupifupi wa mzinda wa US), Haiti ndi Malawi kuchokera ku World Food Programme (kudzera HDX). Mitengo yakumaloko imasinthidwa kukhala madola pamlingo wamasiku ano. 20 lb = 9.07 kg. Mayiko opanda mtengo wa mpunga wamsika amagwiritsira ntchito mulingo wamtengowo.
about3: Mitengo yokhumbira ndi mitengo yamisika yapamsika ya World Food Programme (kudzera mu HDX) kudera la mishoni, msika ndi mwezi zikuwonetsedwa pachinthu chilichonse. Zinthu zopanda mtengo wamsika zimati "mtengo wokhazikitsidwa ndi cholinga".
sentence: United States imatumizidwa {a} ( {b} × {n} ). Malo ena aliwonse amatumizidwa mtengo wake kuchulukitsa nambala yomweyo.
rates_unavail: ⚠ Mitengo yaposachedwa palibe - pogwiritsa ntchito mitengo ya World Bank 2024 ndi mitengo.
machine_note: Zomasulira zimapangidwa ndi makina. Chingerezi ndiye choyambirira.
wl_intro: Mishoni sangalandire phukusi; amagula pa msika wawo wawo. Sankhani zomwe mishoni ikufuna, kenako perekani patsamba lake ndi zolemba pansipa kuti ndalama zigule zinthuzi kwanuko.
wl_give_hint: Koperani cholembacho, dinani Perekani mwachindunji, ndikuchiyika muzolemba za mphatso kapena bokosi la memo.
wl_shared_warn: Mndandanda wogawana: wopangidwa ndi amene adatumiza ulalo. Onani kuti ulalo wa kupatsa ndi tsamba lenileni la mishoni.
